featured_reviews.name: Deepika Pote
featured_reviews.review_text:
There are moments in life when your mind feels trapped in an endless loop of thoughts… when problems don’t just stay outside, they follow you everywhere. That’s exactly where we were... when we decided to try the Kohinoor room at Mystery Room, Andheri West..
and honestly, we didn’t realize then how much we needed it.
From the moment we entered, the energy shifted. The staff welcomed us with such warmth..always smiling, patient, and genuinely excited for us. It didn’t feel like just another activity; it felt like someone quietly telling us, “You’re going to feel better here.”
And then the game began.
What I loved the most was how brilliantly the clues were designed...hilarious, clever, and surprisingly nostalgic.. It was a reminder ...It felt like everything I had ever studied, observed, or casually learned in life was suddenly coming together. Each puzzle wasn’t just a task...it was a spark. A distraction. A reminder that the mind can still play, think, and solve… even when it feels heavy.
There were moments we laughed uncontrollably...cant tell you d exact details , moments we got stuck, and moments where we just looked at each other and said, “Wait… could it be this?” And when things started clicking, it wasn’t just about solving the room...it felt like breaking through something inside us. We dint panic ,got angry, or blamed each other but were focused on problem solving..
And then… that bell rang.
That sound ..it wasn’t just a signal that we had completed the task in hand... It was a jolt.... The exact jolt we didn’t know we needed... For those few minutes, we weren’t thinking about stress, worries, or anything weighing us down. We were just present, quick..and connected... We dint think ... We just did what needed to be done ..and laughed out our hearts....
We walked out lighter. Clearer. Almost reset.
If you’re feeling stuck, overwhelmed, or just mentally exhausted, this place is more than just an escape room. It’s a pause. A shift. A small but powerful break from the chaos inside your head.
For me and my sister, it wasn’t just an experience...it was a moment of healing.
A must-visit. Truly one of the best experiences we’ve ever had.

The room was packed with intricate puzzles and clever clues that kept us on our toes every single second. It felt like we were in a real-life spy movie, racing against time to steal the diamond.

Overall, a perfect mix of challenge, teamwork, and thrill. Great place to visit with friends if you enjoy puzzle-solving and a bit of adventure 👍

featured_reviews.name: Jannat Sorathia
featured_reviews.review_text:
I visited this place on a recommendation with my cousin’s kids and honestly it turned out to be such a fun and memorable experience. The moment you enter you’re welcomed by different animal structures and statues, the entire space is beautifully designed with a jungle theme. Every corner looks vibrant and thoughtfully created, making it perfect for kids who love animals.

What really stood out to me was the mix of fun and learning. They have interactive setups like a bank counter, kitchen area, shopping mall and even a doctor’s clinic, which makes it engaging for kids while also being educational. There are plenty of activities to keep them busy along with cute rides and play areas.

The highlight has to be the crazy maze castle, it’s honestly something you need to experience to understand how exciting it is. I genuinely felt like I wish I was a kid again to enjoy it fully, even adults can have a great time here watching and being part of the fun.

Another thing I really appreciated is how many staff members are always around. They are very attentive and make sure the kids are safe and enjoying at all times. Even if you’re busy or just want to relax for a bit, you can trust them to take good care of your kids. It definitely feels like a very safe and well-managed environment.

They also have a very cute café serving pure vegetarian food. We tried pizza, pasta, fries, boba drinks and coffee, everything was quite good and perfect after all the activities.

I also got to know that the place can be booked for kids’ birthday parties and celebrations, which honestly makes it even more special.

Overall it’s truly a unique experience and definitely one of Mumbai’s first jungle adventure themed parks. I would highly recommend this place to anyone with kids, it’s something they’re going to absolutely love

I recently visited the Rage Room in Sakinaka, Mumbai, and it was amazing! If you need to escape the city's craziness and let out some frustration, this is the place to go.

The staff was friendly and explained everything well. They gave us protective gear and different tools to smash things like glasses, tubelights, tea cups and glass bottles. It was really satisfying to break stuff!
